response.sql: WITH filtered_results AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name as raceName, cr.points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0), per_race_stats AS (SELECT raceId, raceName, AVG(points) as per_race_avg, COUNT(*) as result_count FROM filtered_results GROUP BY raceId, raceName), race_name_avgs AS (SELECT raceName, AVG(per_race_avg) as race_name_avg FROM per_race_stats GROUP BY raceName), with_ratios AS (SELECT prs.raceId, prs.raceName, prs.per_race_avg, prs.result_count, prs.per_race_avg / rna.race_name_avg as ratio FROM per_race_stats prs LEFT JOIN race_name_avgs rna ON prs.raceName = rna.raceName) SELECT * FROM with_ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
